title: SQL Injection — Confirmation, Bypass, and Data Extraction
description: Prefer manual confirmation, use whitespace/encoding transformations for WAF bypass, and extract data by database type
detail:
Confirmation: id=1' / 1 and 1=1 vs 1=2 / sleep(3) time-based blind injection.
Bypass: mixed case, comment splitting /*!50000select*/, spaces → +/**/%0a, double-write selselectect.
sqlmap: --tamper=space2comment,between (try combinations), --random-agent, --delay to avoid crashes.
Data extraction:
- MySQL: UNION or error-based updatexml; read files with load_file('/flag'); --os-shell requires secure_file_priv to allow it
- MSSQL: xp_cmdshell (enable with EXEC sp_configure)
- PostgreSQL: copy to / lo_import; XML out-of-band exfiltration
- SQLite: query sqlite_master for table names
After gaining high privileges: read sensitive target files > dump the database > write a web shell (obtain the path from middleware configuration).
